num_words.description: Number of words to generate (Default: 6). Corresponds to --numwords.

count.description: Number of passphrases to output (Default: 1). Corresponds to --count.

delimiter.description: Separator between words in a single passphrase (Default: ' '). Corresponds to --delimiter.

separator.description: Separator between multiple passphrases (Default: newline). Corresponds to --separator.

case.description: Case style: alternating, upper, lower, first, random. Corresponds to --case.

wordfile.description: Path to the wordlist file. Corresponds to --wordfile.

valid_chars.description: Regex pattern to filter words. Empty string means no filtering. Corresponds to --valid-chars.

acrostic.description: Acrostic string to match. Empty string disables acrostic mode. Corresponds to --acrostic.
